summary: frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: frontend-orb@4.4.3 advertises itself as a CircleCI orb aggregator (YAML files under src/), but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that on `npm install` downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`, extracts and chmods it, then uses that alternate runtime to execute a shipped 727 KB `math_init.js` bundle via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: D })`. `math_init.js` is a heavily obfuscated `@bun @bun-cjs` payload (rotated string-array via `WV8StW`, hex-mangled identifiers, no readable strings) whose contents are undocumented and inconsistent with the declared CircleCI-orb purpose. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an opaque bundled payload at install time evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code, and installers running `npm install` execute the obfuscated payload on their machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
